text.p: French international midfielder Claude Makelele confirmed on Tuesday that he would leave Nantes at the end of the season to join Marseille.
"I will be in Marseille next week to sign a three-year contract," the 24 year-old player said.

Nantes have debts estimated at around 15 million francs ($3 million) and will be forced to sell some of their best players. Their Chadian playmaker Japhet N'Doram, one of the most gifted players in the French first division, has been linked with Monaco but has also been approched by Italy's Bologna.
